text: Dynamic regulation helps rulemakers anticipate how institutions will react to circumstances as they arise, because the feedback process provides decentralized, timely, and institution-specific information, allowing rules to be adjusted ex-ante in anticipation of future contingencies.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Law Dynamic Regulation in a New Institutional Economics Framework (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2267560

isBasedOn.name: Evolution of Law Dynamic Regulation in a New Institutional Economics Framework

abstract: Dynamic regulation helps rulemakers anticipate how institutions will react to circumstances as they arise because the feedback process provides decentralized, timely, and institution-specific information for rulemaking. Rules are adjusted ex-ante in anticipation of future contingencies.
